_metadata.title: IrrigaSense Crop Agronomic Knowledge Base
_metadata.description: Agronomic parameter catalog defining Kc growth stages, Managed Allowable Depletion (MAD), root depth ranges, and soil moisture boundaries. All values derived from standard peer-reviewed agricultural references.
primary_references: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56 (Allen, Pereira, Raes, & Smith, 1998)
FAO Irrigation Water Management: Irrigation Scheduling (Brouwer, Prins, & Heibloem, 1989)
USDA-NRCS National Engineering Handbook, Part 652 (Irrigation Guide, 1997)
Bryla & Strik (2007) - Blueberry Irrigation and Water Relations (USDA-ARS / Oregon State)

initial.description: Seed germination to 10% ground canopy cover.

vegetative.description: Active vegetative canopy expansion to full ground cover and flowering initiation.

mid_season.description: Flowering, fruit set, and primary fruit bulking. Maximum water sensitivity.

late_season.description: Fruit ripening and serial harvesting. Moderate water deficit beneficial to brix content.

mineral_soil.reference: Typical loam / clay loam mineral soil (USDA-NRCS)

tomato.special_agronomic_notes: Highly sensitive to moisture fluctuation during flowering and fruit set (blossom end rot risk).

initial.description: Direct seeding to first true leaf emergence.

vegetative.description: Rapid vine/bush expansion and female flower bud formation.

mid_season.description: Heavy flowering and serial fruit elongation. Constant transpirational draw.

late_season.description: Foliar decline, powdery mildew vulnerability, reduced irrigation requirement.

zucchini.special_agronomic_notes: Moderate drought tolerance, but moisture stress during fruit elongation causes bitter or misshapen fruit.

initial.description: Dormancy break to initial leaf and bud swell.

mid_season.description: Rapid berry enlargement and color break. Peak water consumption.

late_season.description: Post-harvest maintenance and floral primordia formation for subsequent year.

root_depth_ranges_m.reference: Bryla & Strik (2007) - Shallow fibrous root system lacking root hairs

mad.reference: Bryla et al. (2011) - Shallow root zone requires tight allowable depletion (0.30-0.35)

soilless_substrate.reference: Peat / pine bark soilless container mix (Bryla et al., 2011)

blueberry.special_agronomic_notes: Extremely vulnerable to drought stress due to shallow root architecture without root hairs; vulnerable to root rot under waterlogging.
